item.title: Gd‐Mediated Spin‐State Modulation of Co Sites Enhances Oxygen Electrocatalysis in Zn‐Air Battery
item.description:
ورود Gd به سایت‌های Co در GdCo/NC با تنظیم حالت اسپینی، فعالیت ORR را افزایش داده و باتری Zn-air با توان و ظرفیت بالا ساخته می‌شود.
Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Gd incorporation into Co─N─C modulates Co spin states via pronounced spin splitting and orbital-selective polarization, shifting dominant polarization from dz² to dyz and lifting dxz/dyz degeneracy. This optimizes oxygen intermediate adsorption and shifts the rate-determining step from *O protonation to *OH desorption, boosting ORR activity (0.861 V half-wave) and Zn-air battery performance beyond Pt/C benchmarks.
🏷 Zn-air battery · spin-state modulation · ORR · Co-N-C · Gd doping
